This game is going to be ten years old this fall, and I just wanted to say that there is no other game like Rec Room. There is no other game that can reach the popularity and amount of people in its fanbase like Rec Room. Rec Room had a place for literally anything, and after this game has shut down, I can say that the largest game has lost quite a lot of, well, everything. A majority of people, places, creations, and memories have been removed permanently from public access. Fortunately though, there are a lot of Rec Room fan-archives that recover some of the things on Rec Room. I highly recommend that you check them out, but be carefull installing the wrong things. 

This whole shut down reminds me about the Echo VR shutdown, if you remember that. To those who do know about the shutdown, just remember, it was hard moving on, and finding a different game, but the greatest thing was that you succeeded in finding a new game. Just keep looking for that one game that's special to you, and you will succeed. It is not possible for all of us to move on, which isn't a bad thing at all, but when the way gets tough, that is your positive signal to keep charging.

This game was an absolute 10/10, and to see it go, is tragic. Rest in peace, Rec Room.
